thread:
alex: Heads up 1: we need a concrete playbook for "phased preheat" on Dedicated reserved pools before Q3 planning. Customers keep asking for burst smoothness but we can't bleed GPU spend.

maria: Agreed. Goal: let tenants get fast ramp without forcing full prewarms. We sketched options but need defaults, UI, and billing defaults.

devon: Proposal A (conservative): no GPU preheat by default; KV-only preheat enabled. Customers can opt into GPU preheat with a cap. Proposal B (aggressive): GPU preheat on by default for higher tiers with automatic throttled admit.

alex: I prefer A for launch. Lower risk, cheaper defaults.

jing: Telemetry must distinguish warm types. Suggest metrics: kv_preheat_count, gpu_preheat_start, gpu_preheat_seconds, preheat_cost_estimate, admit_step.

sai: Billing: two levers 1) token-equivalent preheat budget (default $10) or 2) percent-of-commit cap (default 0.5%). Ops should be able to raise per-customer.

maria: UX: onboarding modal shows "estimated preheat cost" with a slider to set cap. Also show a toggle: "Opt into GPU preheat for faster bursts" + clear warning.

devon: Admission controller behavior (high level):
- stage0: queued (enqueue requests, no preheat) 0-10m
- stage1 (soft): KV warmed, admit up to soft_ratio of requested concurrency (soft_ratio=0.2 default) 10-30m
- stage2 (full): allow full concurrency, permit GPU preheat up to configured cap 30m+

alex: Can we standardize defaults: preheat_window=10m, soft_window=20m, soft_ratio=0.2, preheat_budget=$10?

jing: Put sample config in repo:```json
{
  "preheat_window": "10m",
  "soft_window": "20m",
  "soft_ratio": "0.2",
  "gpu_preheat_enabled": "false",
  "preheat_budget_usd": "10"
}```

sai: Economics: recommend token-equivalent approach: convert budget to tokens at billing time so customers see it on usage pages. Default budget smaller for trial accounts.

maria: Launch criteria draft: 
- telemetry: admit_latency P50/P95, preheat_cost_by_tenant, stage_transition_count
- canary: preheat_cost leakage < 1.5% of pool spend in first 2 weeks
- UX: onboarding shows estimate and active cap control
- ops: documented manual-override endpoints and rollback (feature-flag kill switch)

devon: Runtime details: separate kill switches for region and pool. Also need region-level preheat quota to avoid one region using cross-region capacity.

ops-bot: infra-bot: Feature flag rollout scheduled: 2025-09-02T04:00:00Z (canary->region->global) :rocket:

alex: Risks: customers declining soft admit because of degraded SLO. We'll make soft admit opt-in per-tenant; guaranteed pools bypass phased flow.

jing: Alerting: create alerts for unexpected GPU_preheat_rate spike and preheat_budget_exhausted per-tenant.

maria: Action items: 
- alex: write canonical phased preheat spec (defaults, gates, UX mock)
- devon: implement admission controller + region caps + feature flags
- jing: telemetry events + dashboard tiles (preheat_cost, stage_durations)
- sai: billing mapping + default budget values for tiers
- ops: runbook for stuck admits + manual force-evict API docs

alex: I'll post the spec in product/roadmap once ready and tag owners. Meeting to lock defaults Monday 09:30 PT.
maria: I'll review and add rollback checklist.
alex: Thanks all.
